references.text: The Levites are brought forward to Aaron the priest to serve him, as part of the same instruction concerning the service of the Levites.
The Levites are given as a gift to Aaron and his sons from the children of Israel, using the same term 'netunim' (given as a gift).
The Lord confirms that the Levites are given as a gift to Aaron, taken out from among the children of Israel for service at the tabernacle.
The Levites are wholly and fully given to the Lord from the children of Israel, in place of all the firstborn.
The Levites are taken in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, which explains why they are 'given' for priestly service.
The tribe of Levi dedicated themselves to the Lord's service after the incident with the golden calf, laying the foundation for their special role.
